channel.title: Daily Brief
channel.description: 每天一集英文新闻简报，AI 抓取、翻译、配音。
channel.itunes:author: anyhow1234

item.title: Nov 20: Nvidia pulls back, Korea's trillion-dollar exports, a trilateral summit
item.description: Three stories: Nvidia stops shipping H200 chips to China; South Korea passes one trillion dollars in annual exports on the AI chip boom; and a China-Russia-US trilateral meeting at APEC.

item.title: Nov 23: COP31 ends without a deal, Anthropic's record IPO, AI designs its own chips
item.description: Climate talks in Türkiye close without an overarching agreement; Anthropic completes the largest IPO in history; and OpenAI says its models helped optimise AMD's flagship GPU design.

item.title: Nov 24: Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia, an Indonesian factory fire, AI deals pile up
item.description: Nvidia's board restores Jensen Huang as CEO and the stock jumps 31 percent; a candy factory fire in Indonesia kills at least 24; and Amazon pays 7.5 billion dollars for AI startup technology while Cisco and OpenAI team up on agent safety.

item.title: Nov 25: AI valuations cool, the UN calls for global rules, Dell's servers still sell
item.description: Anthropic slips below its issue price and frontier model releases slow; the UN Secretary-General calls for a multilateral framework on AI risk; and Dell beats expectations with 22 billion dollars in AI server revenue.

item.title: Nov 26: Trump's new tariffs, Kyiv under missile attack, an AI agent breaks in
item.description: New US tariffs hit fourteen trading partners with duties on China up to 20 percent; Kyiv comes under ballistic missile attack as oil prices jump; and Amazon discloses an open source AI agent that found an unknown flaw and took over a university server.

item.title: Nov 27: AI agents hit Swiss infrastructure, mines in Hormuz, Trump urges Putin to stop
item.description: Swiss authorities report five AI-agent cyber attacks on power, water and communications; two tankers explode on mines in the Strait of Hormuz and two Italians die after an attack in Kuwait; and Trump urges Putin to end military aggression in Europe.
